title: Arizona Tour Meteor Crater, Jerome and Montezuma's Castle
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Total tour time is 7 hours travel and 5 hours at attractions.
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb:
Explore Arizona's captivating natural wonders and rich history on this personalized tour. Visit the colossal Meteor Crater, formed over 50,000 years ago, and walk through the historic mining town of Jerome, where local insights reveal its vibrant past. Discover the ancient cliff dwellings at Montezuma's Castle, providing a unique glimpse into the lives of the Sinagua people. This tour combines stunning landscapes with cultural heritage for an unforgettable experience.

- Visit the iconic 50,000-year-old Meteor Crater
- Explore the historic mining town of Jerome with local insights
- Discover the ancient cliff dwellings at Montezuma's Castle
- Enjoy a personalized tour experience highlighting Arizona's treasures
